verdict.rationale: Postmark's pricing documents fully managed dedicated IPs as an add-on for customers sending 300,000+ emails per month, which covers the 'outgrow shared pools' part of the story. However, nothing in the evidence describes IP warmup. 'Fully managed' implies Postmark handles ramp-up, but there is no automated warmup or published schedule. Missing for 10: documented warmup process (automated ramp-up or published schedule), dedicated IP setup/management docs, independent corroboration of dedicated IP onboarding.
